mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_trace_session (id, user_id, conversation_id, shared_map_id, group_id, draft_id, trigger_source, provider, model, status, started_at, event_count, tool_call_count, error_count, dropped_count, next_seq) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{sharedMapId}, #{groupId}, #{draftId}, #{triggerSource}, #{provider}, #{model}, #{status}, #{startedAt}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
mapper.sql: id, user_id AS userId, conversation_id AS conversationId, shared_map_id AS sharedMapId, group_id AS groupId, draft_id AS draftId, trigger_source AS triggerSource, provider, model, status, started_at AS startedAt, ended_at AS endedAt, duration_ms AS durationMs, prompt_tokens AS promptTokens, completion_tokens AS completionTokens, total_tokens AS totalTokens, event_count AS eventCount, tool_call_count AS toolCallCount, error_count AS errorCount, dropped_count AS droppedCount, next_seq AS nextSeq, last_error_code AS lastErrorCode, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_trace_session WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM agent_trace_session WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM agent_trace_session WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY started_at DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT next_seq FROM agent_trace_session WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_trace_session SET next_seq = #{newSeq}, event_count = event_count + 1, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE agent_trace_session SET tool_call_count = tool_call_count + 1, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE agent_trace_session SET error_count = error_count + 1, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE agent_trace_session
prompt_tokens = COALESCE(prompt_tokens, 0) + #{prompt},
completion_tokens = COALESCE(completion_tokens, 0) + #{completion},
total_tokens = COALESCE(total_tokens, 0) + #{total},
updated_at = NOW(3)
WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE agent_trace_session SET draft_id = COALESCE(draft_id, #{draftId}), updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE agent_trace_session SET shared_map_id = COALESCE(shared_map_id, #{sharedMapId}), group_id = COALESCE(group_id, #{groupId}), updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE agent_trace_session SET status = #{status}, ended_at = #{endedAt}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE agent_trace_session SET dropped_count = dropped_count + #{count}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}
